While the `source` uses a variable (`$_commit`), this is a common and safe practice in AUR packages. No dynamic or untrusted content is fetched or executed at parse time.

The presence of standard packaging metadata and absence of executable code or dangerous constructs in the global scope means this file is safe to parse with `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.
